messages:
deploy-bot: Starting regional rollout v2.3.1 -> us,eu,apac. Slice=alpha-1 traffic=5% per region. Pin=current->v2.3.1. Change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC. /deploy start v2.3.1 --regions us,eu,apac --slice alpha-1 --traffic 5

alice: Copy. Observability dash: https://console.redwood/inference/rollouts/2840001111 :eyes:

ben: Quick capacity check pls — EU dedicated warm pool counts?

sre-sara: EU warm-pool: 46 GPUs idle, US: 130, APAC: 18. Thermal cushion nominal. Baseline p95=240ms. Canary traffic 5% looks fine so far.

ops-jay: APAC low headroom. Recommend hold at 5% until we get another 12 GPUs from pool or shift some us->apac slack.

carla: Release notes for v2.3.1: RP fixes for kv-cache, improved batching heuristics. No schema changes. QA pass on canary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary US 5% complete. Checks: error_rate=0.12% p95=260ms. Advancing US -> 20%.

alice: go for US 20% from me. Monitor /chat-stream closely.

ben: EU pin decision? If warm-pool steady we can mirror US; else pin to v2.3.0 for EU only.

sre-sara: Observability now: EU error_rate=0.15% p95=250ms. But queue depth rising on slice alpha-1 by 15%. Recommend step to 10% first.

ops-jay: Agree. Do not exceed 10% in EU. APAC hold at 5% until +12 GPUs.

deploy-bot: Advancing EU -> 10%. APAC remains 5%. Rollout bot log: /deploy step --region eu --traffic 10

[~10 minutes later]

sre-sara: Alert: EU route /chat-stream error_rate trending up to 2.1% on latest cohort, p95 spiked to 850ms. Thresholds: error>2% OR p95>800ms -> auto-fail.

alice: Seeing the same on dashboard. initiating rollback for EU slice alpha-1.

deploy-bot: Rolling back EU -> v2.3.0 on slice alpha-1. Command: /deploy rollback --region eu --to v2.3.0 --slice alpha-1

ben: Good call. Any tail latency in US after EU rollback?

sre-sara: US stable at 20%, p95 back to 270ms, error 0.14%. No cross-region impact.

carla: Noting in release notes: rolled back EU due to increased errors on /chat-stream. Will open eval ticket for kv-cache regression.

ops-jay: Scheduling a quick capacity bump for APAC tomorrow 03:00 UTC to get it to 30 GPUs.

alice: Postmortem-ish notes: Rollback criteria worked as expected. Suggest adding a canary step for /chat-stream specific endpoints in next run.

deploy-bot: Rollout summary: US->v2.3.1 @20% success, EU rolled back to v2.3.0, APAC stayed @5% hold. Thread closed unless ops followups.

carla: filing follow-up ticket: INF-4827 (kv-cache regression repro + metrics). cc @sre-sara @ops-jay

ops-jay: ack. I'll coordinate APAC capacity bump.

alice: Thanks team. :rocket:
